description_en: Queries the skill group list in the Cloud Customer Service System by skill group channel type, skill group name, or skill group ID
description_zh: 通过技能组渠道类型、技能组名称、技能组id查询悉犀客服工作台技能组列表
kebab_example: aliyun scsp query-skill-groups --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --group-name '自动化技能组' --group-type 2 --group-id 123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySkillGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The unique token for the client request. This token is used for idempotence checks. You can use a UUID to generate the token
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the skill group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the skill group. Valid values:
1: hotline
2: online
4: ticket
parameters.help_zh:
技能组类型,有以下枚举值： 1：热线 2：在线
4：工单
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the skill group
parameters.name: group_id
